prod: Davidoff Cool Water Wave Eau de Toilette 40ml

NEEDS REVIEW: EAN 3614223379897 not found on any retailer page and the 40ml size is not confirmed by 2 sources (one Parfumo review mentions 40ml). There is also a different 2007 Cool Water Wave – check the box (listed as the 2017 version). Pyramid agreed by Parfumo, FragranceNet and Watsons SG (orange blossom only on Parfumo, left out). 2017 per Parfumo, FragranceNet, maximumfragrance.ca. Looks discontinued/limited (perfume.com unavailable). Men. Awaiting photos.
Davidoff Cool Water Woman Eau de Toilette 30ml Gift Set with 75ml Body Lotion

Contents 30ml EDT + 75ml body lotion agreed by Lookfantastic UK, Tesco, Superdrug, Cosmetify and Inish Pharmacy. EAN 3616303806101 not shown on retailer pages (Superdrug versions use 3614221675311 / 3614223240340; Inish SKU COOL-6101 fits); supplier lists this EAN with 3 alternates for the same set. Pyramid: only notes 2+ of Inish, Cosmetify, Lookfantastic agree on (sandalwood/amber left out). Women. Awaiting photos.
Davidoff Cool Water Woman Sea Rose Eau de Toilette 100ml

EAN 3607347462583 matched on gadcet.com (Cool Water Woman Sea Rose 100ml EDT). Pyramid: Osmoz and gadcet agree on every tier (sandalwood only on gadcet, left out). 2013 and perfumer Aurélien Guichard per Osmoz and NST Perfume (FragranceNet 2019 = limited edition). Women. Awaiting photos.
Diesel D Red Eau de Parfum 50ml

EAN 3614273924443 matched on Galaxus CH (D by Diesel Red EDP 50ml); 50ml also on Escentual. Pyramid agreed by John Lewis, Escentual, FragranceNet and NST Perfume. 2024 per NST and FragranceNet. Not D Red Le Parfum (2025). Supplier gender Unisex kept: NST, Galaxus and Parfumdreams call it unisex, but John Lewis, Escentual and FragranceNet market it mainly to men. John Lewis lists it as no longer available online. Awaiting photos.
Diesel Fuel For Life Homme Eau de Toilette 50ml

EAN 3605520386442 matched on Superdrug (Fuel For Life Homme EDT 50ml) and eBay (EDT 50ml men); probably the older L'Oréal-era box (current 50ml uses other codes; supplier also lists 3614272608603). Pyramid agreed by diesel.com 'sensorial notes' and NST Perfume (Superdrug same notes untiered); diesel.com description text gives a different list – slight doubt. 2007 per Fragrancex and NST. Men. Awaiting photos.
Dumont Nitro Red Eau de Parfum 100ml

EAN (UPC 03760060761880) matched on ThePerfumeSpot (Nitro Red by Dumont 100ml EDP, men). Pyramid agreed by Parfumo, FragranceNet and ThePerfumeSpot; Perfume.com and eCosmetics give different lists (ignored). Launch year not confirmed (left out). Men. Awaiting photos.
Dunhill Desire Blue Eau de Toilette 100ml

EAN 0085715801555 matched on Superdrug (Desire Blue EDT 100ml), Carrefour UAE and eBay. Pyramid: Superdrug and Interparfums (licensee) agree on every tier; Osmoz close. Launch year conflicts (2002 Superdrug / 2003 Osmoz) – left out. Family: sources say aromatic green / woody-spicy; shown as Aquatic, Aromatic, Fresh. Men. Awaiting photos.

EAN 0085715807748 matched on Superdrug (Dunhill Driven EDT 60ml, marked no longer available online). Pyramid agreed by Superdrug, Parfumo and Interparfums (bergamot / Italian lemon disputed in the top, left out; amber = Ambroxan). 2021 per Superdrug and Parfumo. Men. Awaiting photos.
Dunhill Mongolian Cashmere Eau de Parfum 100ml

EAN 0085715807595 matched on Superdrug (Dunhill Signature Collection Mongolian Cashmere EDP 100ml). Pyramid: Parfumo and Fragrancenet agree on every tier. 2022 per Parfumo, Fragrancenet, NST. Men (retailers sell it for men; many reviewers find it unisex). Awaiting photos.
Elie Saab Girl of Now Lovely Eau de Parfum 90ml

EAN 7640233341070 matched on Shop-Apotheke (Girl of Now Lovely EDP 90ml); 90ml EDP also on Lookfantastic. Pyramid: Lookfantastic, Shop-Apotheke and Beauty Bay agree (blackcurrant bud placement and cashmeran/ambroxan disputed, left out). 2022 per Parfumo and NST. Women. Awaiting photos.
